ucs.title: [LLM] Scattered Spider (Octo Tempest / UNC3944) redundant RMM beachhead — AnyDesk + ScreenConnect + Splashtop + Fleetdeck installed outside the IT
ucs.description: Hunts the actor's characteristic 'drop two or more commodity RMMs on the first workstation we touch' tradecraft. Scattered Spider socially engineers helpdesks into resetting a victim's password, signs in from a residential proxy, then immediately installs multiple remote-monitoring agents (AnyDesk, ConnectWise ScreenConnect, Splashtop, Fleetdeck, Pulseway, TacticalRMM, ngrok, RustDesk) as redundant persistence — even on hosts that already run the org's sanctioned RMM. CISA AA23-320A, Microsoft Octo Tempest, Mandiant UNC3944, and CrowdStrike Scattered Spider reporting all flag this exact stacki
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parents from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("AnyDesk.exe","ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe","ScreenConnect.WindowsClient.exe","ScreenConnect.ClientSetup.exe","SplashtopStreamer.exe","SRService.exe","SRManager.exe","fleetdeck_agent.exe","fleetdeck_commander_launcher.exe","PulsewayMonitor.exe","tacticalrmm.exe","rport.exe","ngrok.exe","rustdesk.exe","TeamViewer.exe","LogMeIn.exe") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name _time span=1h
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| eval rmm_family=case(match(process_name,"(?i)anydesk"),"anydesk", match(process_name,"(?i)screenconnect"),"screenconnect", match(process_name,"(?i)splashtop|sr(service|manager)"),"splashtop", match(process_name,"(?i)fleetdeck"),"fleetdeck", match(process_name,"(?i)pulseway"),"pulseway", match(process_name,"(?i)tactical|rport"),"tacticalrmm", match(process_name,"(?i)ngrok"),"ngrok", match(process_name,"(?i)rustdesk"),"rustdesk", match(process_name,"(?i)teamviewer"),"teamviewer", match(process_name,"(?i)logmein"),"logmein", 1=1,"other")
| stats min(firstTime) as firstTime max(lastTime) as lastTime values(process_name) as binaries values(cmdline) as cmdlines values(parents) as parent_processes dc(rmm_family) as distinct_rmm_families values(rmm_family) as rmm_families by dest user
| where distinct_rmm_families>=2 AND NOT match(user,"(?i)(\$$|system|local service|network service)")
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
| sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let RMM = dynamic(["anydesk.exe","screenconnect.clientservice.exe","screenconnect.windowsclient.exe","screenconnect.clientsetup.exe","splashtopstreamer.exe","srservice.exe","srmanager.exe","fleetdeck_agent.exe","fleetdeck_commander_launcher.exe","pulsewaymonitor.exe","tacticalrmm.exe","rport.exe","ngrok.exe","rustdesk.exe","teamviewer.exe","logmein.exe"]);
let Family = (n:string) {
    case(n has "anydesk","anydesk",
         n has "screenconnect","screenconnect",
         n has "splashtop" or n has "srservice" or n has "srmanager","splashtop",
         n has "fleetdeck","fleetdeck",
         n has "pulseway","pulseway",
         n has "tacticalrmm" or n has "rport","tacticalrmm",
         n has "ngrok","ngrok",
         n has "rustdesk","rustdesk",
         n has "teamviewer","teamviewer",
         n has "logmein","logmein",
         "other")
};
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| extend LowerName = tolower(FileName)
| where LowerName in (RMM)
| where AccountName !endswith "$" and AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| extend RmmFamily = Family(LowerName)
| summarize FirstSeen = min(Timestamp),
            LastSeen  = max(Timestamp),
            Binaries  = make_set(FileName, 25),
            SampleCmd = any(ProcessCommandLine),
            Parents   = make_set(InitiatingProcessFileName, 10),
            DistinctFamilies = dcount(RmmFamily),
            Families  = make_set(RmmFamily, 10)
         by DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName
| where DistinctFamilies >= 2
| order by FirstSeen desc

         n has "pulseway","pulseway",

         n has "logmein","logmein",
         "other")

SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend BaseName = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| where BaseName in (RMM)
| where TargetUserName !endswith "$" and TargetUserName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| extend RmmFamily = Family(BaseName)
| summarize FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
            LastSeen  = max(TimeGenerated),
            Binaries  = make_set(NewProcessName, 25),
            SampleCmd = any(CommandLine),
            Parents   = make_set(ParentProcessName, 10),
            DistinctFamilies = dcount(RmmFamily),
            Families  = make_set(RmmFamily, 10)
         by Computer, TargetUserName
| where DistinctFamilies >= 2
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) (@EventID:1 OR @EventID:4688) @Image:(*\AnyDesk.exe OR *\anydesk.exe OR *\ANYDESK.EXE OR *\ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe OR *\screenconnect.clientservice.exe OR *\ScreenConnect.WindowsClient.exe OR *\ScreenConnect.ClientSetup.exe OR *\SplashtopStreamer.exe OR *\splashtopstreamer.exe OR *\SRService.exe OR *\SRManager.exe OR *\fleetdeck_agent.exe OR *\fleetdeck_commander_launcher.exe OR *\PulsewayMonitor.exe OR *\pulsewaymonitor.exe OR *\tacticalrmm.exe OR *\rport.exe OR *\ngrok.exe OR *\rustdesk.exe OR *\TeamViewer.exe OR *\teamviewer.exe OR *\LogMeIn.exe) -@User:(*$ OR SYSTEM OR "LOCAL SERVICE" OR "NETWORK SERVICE")
ucs.rationale: Generic 'unauthorised RMM' rules fire on shadow-IT users (one tool) and on managed IT (one tool). Scattered Spider's signature is the *stack* — multiple commodity RMM families on one host inside hours, because they assume the SOC will burn one and want a second/third channel. The two-family threshold is what makes this Scattered-Spider-specific vs noise; it directly matches CISA AA23-320A's catalo

ucs.title: [LLM] Scattered Spider (0ktapus / Muddled Libra) help-desk-driven Entra ID/Okta MFA hijack — attacker-controlled authenticator registered minutes
ucs.description: Hunts the actor's signature initial-access chain: vish the IT help desk → admin performs a self-service password reset or 'Reset password (by admin)' on the targeted account → attacker signs in from a residential/VPS proxy → attacker immediately registers a new authenticator (Microsoft Authenticator, FIDO key, phone) on the account to lock the legitimate user out. This is the exact playbook Microsoft Octo Tempest, Mandiant UNC3944, and Okta's 2022/2023 advisories tie to Scattered Spider, and it is what produced the MGM, Caesars, Twilio, Mailchimp, and Reddit intrusions.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=true min(_time) as resetTime from datamodel=Change where (Change.action=updated OR Change.action=modified) AND Change.object_category=user AND (Change.command="Reset password (by admin)" OR Change.command="Reset user password" OR Change.command="Change user password" OR Change.command="Update user" OR Change.result="Self-service password reset (SSPR)") by Change.user as resetActor Change.object as targetUpn
| `drop_dm_object_name(Change)`
| join type=inner targetUpn [
    | tstats summariesonly=true min(_time) as mfaTime values(Change.command) as mfaActions values(Change.src) as mfaSrcIp from datamodel=Change where Change.object_category=user AND (Change.command="User registered security info" OR Change.command="Add registered security info" OR Change.command="Update registered security info" OR Change.command="User started security info registration" OR Change.command="Add user authentication method" OR Change.command="Register device") by Change.object as targetUpn Change.user as mfaActor
    | `drop_dm_object_name(Change)`
]
| eval gapMinutes = round((mfaTime - resetTime)/60, 1)
| where gapMinutes >= 0 AND gapMinutes <= 60
| join type=outer targetUpn [
    | tstats summariesonly=true values(Authentication.src) as signinSrcIp values(Authentication.app) as signinApp from datamodel=Authentication where Authentication.signature_id IN ("50053","50140","50158","50074","0") by Authentication.user as targetUpn _time span=1h
    | `drop_dm_object_name(Authentication)`
]
| table resetTime mfaTime gapMinutes targetUpn resetActor mfaActor mfaActions mfaSrcIp signinSrcIp signinApp
| sort - resetTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let Window = 60m;
let Resets = CloudAppEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where Application in~ ("Office 365","Microsoft Entra ID","Azure Active Directory")
    | where ActionType in ("Reset password (by admin).","Reset user password.","Change user password.","Self-service password reset (SSPR).")
    | extend Target = tostring(ActivityObjects[0].Name)
    | project ResetTime = Timestamp, Target, ResetActor = AccountDisplayName, ResetActorUpn = tostring(parse_json(tostring(RawEventData)).UserId), ResetSrcIp = IPAddress, ResetCountry = CountryCode, ResetUa = UserAgent;
let MfaAdds = CloudAppEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType in ("User registered security info.","User started security info registration.","Add registered security info.","Update registered security info.","Add user authentication method.","Register device.")
    | extend Target = tostring(ActivityObjects[0].Name)
    | project MfaTime = Timestamp, Target, MfaActor = AccountDisplayName, MfaAction = ActionType, MfaSrcIp = IPAddress, MfaCountry = CountryCode, MfaUa = UserAgent, MfaIsp = ISP;
Resets
| join kind=inner MfaAdds on Target
| where MfaTime between (ResetTime .. ResetTime + Window)
| extend GapMinutes = datetime_diff('minute', MfaTime, ResetTime),
         CrossIp = tostring(ResetSrcIp) != tostring(MfaSrcIp),
         CrossCountry = tostring(ResetCountry) != tostring(MfaCountry)
| join kind=leftouter (
    AADSignInEventsBeta
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | project SignInTime = Timestamp, Target = AccountUpn, SignInIp = IPAddress, SignInCountry = Country, SignInIsp = NetworkLocationDetails, SignInUa = UserAgent, SignInRisk = RiskLevelDuringSignIn
  ) on Target
| where SignInTime between (ResetTime - 30m .. MfaTime + 5m)
| summarize arg_min(MfaTime, *), SignInIps = make_set(SignInIp, 5), SignInCountries = make_set(SignInCountry, 5), SignInRisks = make_set(SignInRisk, 5)
         by Target, ResetTime, MfaAction
| where CrossIp or CrossCountry or SignInRisks has_any ("high","medium")
| project ResetTime, MfaTime, GapMinutes, Target, ResetActor, ResetSrcIp, ResetCountry, MfaActor, MfaAction, MfaSrcIp, MfaCountry, MfaIsp, SignInIps, SignInCountries, SignInRisks
| order by ResetTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let Window = 60m;
let Resets = AuditLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where OperationName in ("Reset password (by admin)","Reset user password","Change user password","Self-service password reset (SSPR)")
    | extend Target = tolower(tostring(TargetResources[0].userPrincipalName))
    | extend ResetActor = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName), ResetSrcIp = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress)
    | project ResetTime = TimeGenerated, Target, ResetActor, ResetSrcIp, ResetOperation = OperationName;
let MfaAdds = AuditLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where OperationName in ("User registered security info","User started security info registration","Add registered security info","Update registered security info","Admin registered security info","Register device")
    | extend Target = tolower(tostring(TargetResources[0].userPrincipalName))
    | extend MfaActor = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName), MfaSrcIp = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress)
    | project MfaTime = TimeGenerated, Target, MfaActor, MfaSrcIp, MfaAction = OperationName;
Resets
| join kind=inner MfaAdds on Target
| where MfaTime between (ResetTime .. ResetTime + Window)
| extend GapMinutes = datetime_diff('minute', MfaTime, ResetTime)
| join kind=leftouter (
    SigninLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | extend Target = tolower(UserPrincipalName)
    | project SignInTime = TimeGenerated, Target, SignInIp = IPAddress, SignInCountry = tostring(LocationDetails.countryOrRegion), SignInRisk = RiskLevelDuringSignIn, SignInApp = AppDisplayName, SignInResult = ResultType, SignInUa = UserAgent
  ) on Target
| where SignInTime between (ResetTime - 30m .. MfaTime + 5m)
| summarize arg_min(MfaTime, *), SignInIps = make_set(SignInIp, 5), SignInCountries = make_set(SignInCountry, 5), SignInRisks = make_set(SignInRisk, 5), SignInApps = make_set(SignInApp, 5)
         by Target, ResetTime, MfaAction
| where (ResetSrcIp != MfaSrcIp) or SignInRisks has_any ("high","medium") or array_length(SignInCountries) > 1
| project ResetTime, MfaTime, GapMinutes, Target, ResetActor, ResetSrcIp, MfaActor, MfaAction, MfaSrcIp, SignInIps, SignInCountries, SignInRisks, SignInApps
| order by ResetTime desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:azure.activeDirectory (@evt.name:("Reset password (by admin)" OR "Reset user password" OR "Change user password" OR "Self-service password reset (SSPR)" OR "User registered security info" OR "User started security info registration" OR "Add registered security info" OR "Update registered security info" OR "Add user authentication method" OR "Register device")) OR source:okta (@evt.name:(user.account.reset_password OR user.mfa.factor.reset_all OR user.mfa.factor.activate OR user.mfa.factor.update OR user.account.update_password OR user.mfa.factor.deactivate) @outcome.result:SUCCESS)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=IdpAuthenticationLog OR #event_simpleName=IdpAuditLog
| EventName=/^(reset.password|change.password|user\.registered\.security\.info|add.registered.security.info|user.mfa.factor.(activate|update|reset_all)|user.account.reset_password|user.account.update_password|register.device)/i
| Outcome=/(SUCCESS|success)/i
| groupBy([TargetUserPrincipal], function=[
    min(@timestamp, as=FirstAction),
    max(@timestamp, as=LastAction),
    collect([EventName], multival=true, as=Actions),
    collect([SrcIp], multival=true, as=SrcIps),
    collect([SrcCountry], multival=true, as=Countries),
    count(field=SrcIp, distinct=true, as=DistinctSrcIps)
  ])
| (LastAction - FirstAction) <= 3600000 AND Actions=/reset.*password/i AND Actions=/(register|add).*security.info|mfa.factor.(activate|update)/i AND DistinctSrcIps >= 2
| sort(FirstAction, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: The password-reset → fresh-IP-signin → attacker-MFA-enrollment chain inside a 60-minute window is the fingerprint of every public Scattered Spider intrusion (MGM Sept 2023, Caesars Aug 2023, Twilio Aug 2022, Riot Games Jan 2023, Reddit Feb 2023, M&S/Co-op 2025). A reset alone is benign (helpdesks do them constantly). An MFA-method-add alone is benign (legitimate users enroll new phones). The actor
